# My App

![My App logo](./assets/logo.png)

My App helps you manage tasks, track projects, collaborate with your team, and sync everything across your devices.

## Features

- Task management with due dates and priorities
- Project tracking with progress bars and milestones
- Team collaboration with comments and file sharing
- Offline mode so you can work without internet

## Install

1. Download the installer.
2. Run the installer.
3. Follow the setup wizard.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install my-app
```
